paper.title_en: Multi-Spin Perturbations, Thermodynamics, and Observational Signatures of Reissner-Nordstrom Black Holes in Bumblebee Gravity
paper.abstract_en: In this paper, we present a comprehensive investigation into the dynamical and thermodynamic properties of the charged Reissner-Nordström (RN) black hole (BH) in the bumblebee gravity framework, where spontaneous Lorentz symmetry breaking (LSB) occurs. To analyze the dynamical behavior, we apply the unified Teukolsky master equation within the Newman-Penrose formalism to evaluate massless field perturbations of arbitrary spins ($s=0, 1/2, 1, 3/2, 2$). By deriving the corresponding effective potentials, we compute the quasinormal modes (QNMs) frequencies using the Padé-improved 6th-order WKB approximation and the Asymptotic Iteration Method (AIM) and evaluate the greybody factors for all perturbing fields, demonstrating how the LSB parameter $L$ and the BH charge $Q$ modify the spacetime's damped oscillations and wave propagation. We further assess the observational prospects of these QNMs by determining the black-hole mass ranges accessible to current and future gravitational-wave detectors, including LISA, Virgo, and LIGO. Moreover, we investigate the modified thermodynamic structure, calculating the Hawking temperature, entropy with logarithmic thermal corrections and heat capacity. Our thermodynamic analysis reveals a second-order phase transition whose critical radius is heavily governed by the background charge. These combined findings provide valuable theoretical insights into how Lorentz violation affects the physical stability, thermal evolution, and phase structure of charged BHs.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文全面研究了Bumblebee引力中带电磁荷的Reissner-Nordström黑洞的自旋扰动、热力学与观测特征，涵盖准正规模式、灰体因子和相变分析，方法严谨，主题相关。
decision.title_zh: Bumblebee引力中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的多自旋扰动、热力学与观测特征
decision.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们对Bumblebee引力框架下带电的Reissner-Nordström (RN) 黑洞 (BH) 的动力学和热力学性质进行了全面研究，其中自发洛伦兹对称性破缺 (LSB) 发生。为了分析动力学行为，我们在Newman-Penrose形式中应用统一的Teukolsky主方程，评估任意自旋 ($s=0, 1/2, 1, 3/2, 2$) 的无质量场扰动。通过推导相应的有效势，我们使用Padé改进的6阶WKB近似和渐近迭代方法 (AIM) 计算准正规模 (QNMs) 频率，并评估所有扰动场的灰体因子，展示了LSB参数 $L$ 和BH电荷 $Q$ 如何修改时空的阻尼振荡和波传播。我们进一步通过确定当前和未来引力波探测器（包括LISA、Virgo和LIGO）可触及的黑洞质量范围，评估这些QNMs的观测前景。此外，我们研究了修正的热力学结构，计算了霍金温度、带有对数热修正的熵和热容量。我们的热力学分析揭示了一个二阶相变，其临界半径主要由背景电荷决定。这些综合发现为洛伦兹破坏如何影响带电BH的物理稳定性、热演化和相结构提供了宝贵的理论见解。
